tasks.label: Scarab remoto: verificar acesso
args: set -eu; cd "$HOME/services/scarab"; podman --version; podman compose version; git status --short --branch

tasks.label: Scarab remoto: atualizar do origin
args: set -eu; cd "$HOME/services/scarab"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'ERRO: o checkout remoto possui alteracoes locais.' >&2; exit 1; }; git pull --ff-only

tasks.label: Scarab remoto: testes unitarios Linux
args: set -eu; cd "$HOME/services/scarab"; podman run --rm -e UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/tmp/venv -v "$PWD:/workspace:ro" --tmpfs /workspace/src/scarab.egg-info:rw --tmpfs /workspace/.pytest_cache:rw --tmpfs /workspace/build:rw -w /workspace ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.13-bookworm-slim uv run --frozen --extra dev --no-editable pytest -q

tasks.label: Scarab remoto: validar Compose
args: set -eu; cd "$HOME/services/scarab"; test -f .env || { echo 'ERRO: crie ~/services/scarab/.env diretamente no host remoto.' >&2; exit 1; }; test -f config/config.json || { echo 'ERRO: crie config/config.json no checkout remoto.' >&2; exit 1; }; podman compose -f "$PWD/containers/podman-compose.yml" config >/dev/null; echo 'Compose remoto valido.'

tasks.label: Scarab remoto: subir e reconstruir
args: set -eu; cd "$HOME/services/scarab"; podman compose -f "$PWD/containers/podman-compose.yml" up -d --build; podman compose -f "$PWD/containers/podman-compose.yml" ps

tasks.label: Scarab remoto: logs
args: cd "$HOME/services/scarab" && podman compose -f "$PWD/containers/podman-compose.yml" logs --tail=200 app db
